item.text:
Scope: 2024 evidence only. I used background context only where it was necessary to interpret a 2024 event, and I did not try to turn pre-2024 history into evidence.

**Bottom line**
Biden’s 2024 record looked mixed. On the favorable side, official economic data were still solid through mid-2024, and he won a major bipartisan foreign-aid package plus a shutdown-averting spending deal. On the critical side, the June 27 debate triggered a collapse in confidence about his fitness, and he ended his reelection campaign on July 21.

**Accepted claims**
- [Employment Situation News Release - 2024 M04 Results](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/empsit_05032024.htm) — U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — May 3, 2024.  
  Claim: April payrolls rose by 175,000 and unemployment was 3.9%, which supports a favorable reading of the economy during Biden’s term in 2024.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here; I did not inspect the repository rubric in this isolated workflow.

- [Consumer Price Index News Release - 2024 M06 Results](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_07112024.htm) — U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — July 11, 2024.  
  Claim: CPI-U fell 0.1% in June and was up 3.0% over 12 months, evidence that inflation had eased by mid-2024.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here.

- [Gross Domestic Product, Second Quarter 2024 (Advance Estimate)](https://www.bea.gov/news/2024/gross-domestic-product-second-quarter-2024-advance-estimate) — U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis — July 25, 2024.  
  Claim: Real GDP grew at a 2.8% annual rate in Q2 2024, another favorable macro indicator for the administration.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here.

- [Biden says the US is rushing weaponry to Ukraine as he signs a $95 billion war aid measure into law](https://apnews.com/article/b72aed9b195818735d24363f2bc34ea4) — Associated Press — April 24, 2024.  
  Claim: Biden signed a large bipartisan aid package for Ukraine, Israel, Taiwan and the Indo-Pacific, showing legislative execution and alliance leadership.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here.

- [Biden signs a package of spending bills passed by Congress just hours before a shutdown deadline](https://apnews.com/article/853b90ae025108be4ee98b939facd913) — Associated Press — March 9, 2024.  
  Claim: Biden signed a stopgap bundle that avoided a shutdown, evidence of baseline governing capacity in a divided Congress.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here.

- [CBP Releases June 2024 Monthly Update](https://www.cbp.gov/newsroom/national-media-release/cbp-releases-june-2024-monthly-update) — U.S. Customs and Border Protection — July 15, 2024.  
  Claim: After Biden’s June 4 border proclamation, southwest-border encounters fell sharply and June was the lowest monthly total since January 2021. This is mixed evidence: it supports responsiveness, but it also confirms the border remained a major problem area.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here.

- [Biden's shaky Trump debate alarms Democrats, raises questions for his campaign](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/a-disaster-bidens-shaky-start-in-debate-with-trump-rattles-democrats-3500586) — Reuters via Investing.com — June 27, 2024.  
  Claim: Biden’s debate performance rattled Democrats and raised fresh doubts about his fitness and ability to campaign effectively.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here.

- [WATCH: Biden holds news conference after NATO summit](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/watch-live-biden-holds-news-conference-after-nato-summit) — PBS News / Associated Press — July 11, 2024.  
  Claim: Biden defended his domestic and foreign policies and mostly held up under tough questioning, but the event still reflected ongoing scrutiny of his age and capacity.  
  Question IDs: not assigned here.

- [Biden drops out of the 2024 race after disastrous debate inflamed age concerns. VP Harris gets his nod](https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/) — Associated Press — July 21, 2024.  
  Claim: Biden ended his reelection bid after the debate-driven collapse in confidence, which is strong critical evidence about how his 2024 term was perceived.
